semantics.tooltip_detection: supplied visible/hidden transitions; repeated visible samples collapse to one appearance
semantics.association: All channels share one interaction_ref -> independently reviewed outcome association. Tooltip channel additionally requires a live matching tooltip. Hotkeys and cheats require their canonical owner catalog identities.
semantics.outcome: operator_reviewed true and evidence_ref required for reviewed successes; not proof of causal efficacy
semantics.learning: no automatic training; at least 3 reviewed outcomes, 3 helpful, 75 percent helpful for eligibility only
semantics.input_channel_action_not_success: A recorded hotkey or cheat invocation never establishes requested mode, in-game command ACK, inventory change or outcome.
semantics.window_projection: 3/5/10/30/60-minute windows include tooltip, hotkey and cheat per-channel action totals, review outcomes and pending results; no double counting.

hotkey.semantics: Verified canonical identity of supplied hotkey trigger in stated mode, not proof that requested mode or UI effect occurred.

cheat.semantics: Identifies catalog-approved cheat family/template. Does not store typed command, arguments, funds amount or claim cheat effect.

existing_tooltip.semantics: Still requires matching currently visible tooltip and continues unchanged.

cross_session_memory.on_opt_in_hover: Each accepted tooltip/action/outcome event projects into bounded patch and lot qualified index; duplicate tooltip visible edges produce no second count
cross_session_memory.scope: Exact game patch and active lot, or UNKNOWN_PATCH/UNKNOWN_LOT candidate only
cross_session_memory.review: Three or more favorable reviewed outcomes and >=75% among reviewed -> REVIEWED_ASSOCIATION_NOT_GAME_PROOF
cross_session_memory.privacy: No raw text/screenshots/typed commands, no global hooks, no model promotion or game click
cross_session_memory.repair: A failed shared index write reports AFFORDANCE_INDEX_REPAIR_REQUIRED without falsely claiming durable memory; original session event persists
cross_session_memory.canonical_terms: contracts/glossary.v1.json remains reviewed taxonomy, not automatically dirtied during user gameplay
